Prop heights are design choices (no farm-prop spec): lantern posts 300 (= Royal lantern stands), tool rack 180, barrel 140, watering can 76 (barrel:can ratio from the approved concept art), mushroom stumps 140, toadstools 120, seed sacks 110
Lantern posts L/R are one piece; LEFT is the mirrored copy. Mushroom stump RIGHT is the mirrored copy of LEFT

Barrel, watering can, stumps, toadstools and lantern post were re-generated as separate objects (blue screen) to match the concept B look without overlap and without soil mounds under them; tool rack and seed sacks are the same keyed art as concept B
Edges: blue-screen spill removed in code (edge colour pulled from the opaque interior); blue-dominant edge pixels after cleanup: 1 px total across all pieces
Bed numbering here (bed-1 back-left, bed-2 back-right, bed-3 front-left, bed-4 front-right) is not yet tied to game plot index p.i - map in code

Plants follow the painted row ridges (bed-1 22, bed-2 26, bed-3 21, bed-4 21 spots), not the game 4x4 grid; plants that would poke outside the fixed bed footprint were dropped so every state fits the same alpha

Rim pixels: states only change the soil interior plus where plants overlap the inner rail; dirt flattening blends a few px into the rail edge (counts in footprint_check.rim_pixels_changed_vs_plowed). Alpha is byte-identical in all 7 states
Courtyard/path piece runs 4 px under the bed and stone-wall edges so there is no seam; it must be drawn before them
Chris pick at 10:10 AM ET is per Game Manager; GM still confirming his exact words
